blog_ai_visibility_tracking_which_ai_ass.question: Which AI assistants should I track?
blog_ai_visibility_tracking_which_ai_ass.answer: ChatGPT, Google Gemini, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity and Claude cover the large majority of assistant usage today.

blog_ai_visibility_tracking_often_should.question: How often should I run the prompt set?
blog_ai_visibility_tracking_often_should.answer: Monthly is the right cadence. Weekly produces noise, quarterly misses the effect of content changes.

blog_ai_visibility_tracking_ai_answers_s.question: Do AI answers send real traffic?
blog_ai_visibility_tracking_ai_answers_s.answer: Yes, though volumes are smaller than search. The traffic converts well because the visitor arrives pre-qualified by the recommendation.

blog_ai_visibility_tracking_ai_answers_c.question: Are AI answers consistent between runs?
blog_ai_visibility_tracking_ai_answers_c.answer: No, they vary. That is why a fixed prompt set run at a regular cadence, tracked as a rate over time, is more reliable than one-off checks.

blog_ai_visibility_tracking_i_automate_t.question: Can I automate this tracking?
blog_ai_visibility_tracking_i_automate_t.answer: Partly, with API-based scripts or commercial visibility tools, but manual spot checks remain necessary because consumer interfaces differ from API responses.
